name: Hypnos Fuck
source:
His school life was one of violence, persecution and apathy.
Day after day his heart was broken, injuries sustained, dignity shattered.

All by a punk named Yuuki Izumio, and her gang.

He dreamed of the ultimate revenge: to indulge a dark pleasure.
As he walked home from school one day......

"You there walking, you boy, how about I read your fortune?"

The man who called to him took him to a secluded gypsy's tent.
He was an Egyptian by the name of Al Votokor
This mystic man had insights to his life nobody could possibly guess.
Then he said: "You should conquer the souls of the sows."

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE164524.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
他的校园生活充满暴力、迫害与冷漠。日复一日，内心破碎，身体受伤，尊严被践踏。

这一切都是朋克女孩泉尾优希和她的团伙造成的。

他梦想着终极复仇：沉溺于黑暗的快感。某天放学回家时……

“喂，走路的那个男孩，要不要让我帮你算一卦？”

叫住他的人把他带进偏僻的吉卜赛帐篷。那名叫阿尔·沃托科尔的埃及神秘术士，看穿了他人生中无人能够猜到的秘密。

随后，他说道：“你应该征服那些母猪的灵魂。”

[来源：[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE164524.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
